citations.long: You held dietary supplements and packaging under conditions that lead to mix-up, contamination, or deterioration.
You did not establish product specifications for the identity, purity, strength, and composition of the finished dietary supplement.
You did not qualify a supplier of a component by establishing the reliability of the supplier's certificate of analysis through confirmation of the results of their tests or examinations.

citations.short: Specifications met identity,purity, strength, comp,; basis
citations.long: You did not provide adequate documentation of your basis for determining that compliance with the specificatio s you selected for identity, purity, strength, and composition will ensure that the finished batch of dietary supplement meets the specificatio s.

citations.short: Documentation specifications met; exempted, periodic testing
citations.long: You did not document why an exempted product specification is met without verification by periodically testing the finished batch.
You did not ensure that the tests or examinations that you used to determine whether the specifications are met are appropriate, scientifically valid methods.

The written instructions in your master manufacturing record did not include specific actions to perform and verify points, steps, or stages in the manufacturing process where control is necessary to ensure that the dietary supplement is packaged and labeled as specified in the master manufacturing record.
Your batch production records did not include documentation, at the time of performance, of the manufacture of the batch.
